summary: Tested COMM-04 (marketing campaign cost -> Beban Pemasaran GL) and LN-042-T03 (roll label reprint keeps the same EPC and prints the current qty), backend and frontend, plus the LN-041/MDQ regression. Backend: all 17 new pytest cases pass against the public URL. The requested files pass when run one at a time: test_l04_ln041_mdq_select (2), test_l04_mdq_cut (4), test_l04_mdq_cut_edge (6), test_saga_lock_registry (1); smoke_comm04_ln042t03.py prints ALL PASS. Frontend: the campaign costs modal loads and shows the budget summary. Recording a cost works, realized/remaining update, an empty amount shows its error, and the 390px layout is fine. The RFID Tags reprint shows 'cetak ke-N' and 'qty terkini'. CRITICAL UI BUG: voiding a cost from the UI does not work. Clicking the submit button in the void modal ('Batalkan biaya') reloads the whole page to /? and lands on admin-home. No API call is sent.

minor.issue: The frontend reprint calls lookup without record=false. Every label reprint therefore writes a roll_scans row and overwrites roll.last_scan, so reprints are logged as fake 'scans' in the roll's trail.
There is no idempotency key or duplicate guard. A double submit (the UI busy flag only covers one tab) or a client retry posts two journal entries.
MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'] is hardcoded. It should use MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from the env.

ui_bugs.issue: VoidCostModal is rendered inside the outer FormModal's children, so it sits inside the outer <form>. That gives a nested <form>. Clicking mkt-cost-void-submit does a native GET submit to '/?', which reloads the whole page (navigations seen: '/?' then '/?view=admin-home'). mktApi.voidCost is never called, so a user cannot void a cost from the UI. The same thing happens with a short reason and with a valid one. Voiding through the API works and the row then shows 'batal (pembalik JE…)' correctly.

issues: mkt-cost-date uses the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn calendar/date picker.

On mobile the user must first tap the 'mobile-force-desktop' button to reach ?view=mkt-campaigns (the mobile shell has no marketing campaigns). After that the modal fits 390px with no horizontal overflow.
The KPI card says 'Roll Belum Ber-tag 5000' but the tab says 'Belum Ber-tag (500)' (the list is capped). This can confuse users; show the full count or say the list is truncated.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix the nested form in frontend/src/features/marketing/CampaignCostsModal.jsx. Render <VoidCostModal> outside the outer <FormModal>: return <>…<FormModal/>{voiding && <VoidCostModal/>}</>, or use a portal. Then rebuild the static bundle and confirm that void from the UI calls POST /costs/{id}/void and the row shows 'batal'.
Make RfidTagsView.reprintByCode call /rfid/lookup with params {code, record:false} so a reprint is not recorded as a scan.
Optional: add an idempotency key or client request id to POST /marketing/campaigns/{cid}/costs.
Optional: replace the native date input in the cost form with the shadcn date picker.
critical_code_review_comments: Nested-form risk: FormModal wraps children in a <form> whenever onSubmit is passed. Any FormModal opened inside another FormModal's children has the same bug. Audit other features that nest modals.
marketing_cost_service.record_cost: if post_cash_durable fails, the compensation sets the cash txn to void and deletes the cost row, but the MCC number is already used (gap). Acceptable, but log it.
void_cost: when the saga claim fails it raises 409. Concurrent voids gave exactly one 200 and one 409, with exactly one reversal JE.
list_costs caps rows at 500 (to_list(500)), but realized_by_campaign aggregates everything. With more than 500 costs the modal's list and its realized total would disagree.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (void from UI broken; everything else passes)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. TEST_T1 / TEST_UI campaigns, their costs, cash txns and JEs, roll_label_prints, the rfid tag and print jobs created on roll_e0ca983743fe (RL-00001), and the UI-created roll_scans were all deleted. The roll document was restored from a snapshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No ent_ksc roll has an RFID tag in the seed data. To get a non-null EPC, test_comm04_ln042t03_regression.py creates an rfid_tag print job on an untagged roll and calls mark-printed (this encodes the tag), then restores the roll. RFID Tags view key is ?view=cs-rfid-tags (not rfid-tags); reprint buttons are in the 'Belum Ber-tag' tab (rfid-untagged-reprint-<rollId>). At 390px the app shows the mobile shell; click mobile-force-desktop to reach the desktop views. Retest UI void (mkt-cost-void-submit) after the nested-form fix.
rca of the issue: Repro: open ?view=mkt-campaigns, click 'Biaya', record a cost, click 'Batalkan', type a reason, click 'Batalkan biaya'. The page reloads to /? and then admin-home; no POST is made. Cause: CampaignCostsModal renders {voiding && <VoidCostModal/>} as a child of <FormModal onSubmit=...>, which wraps its children in <form>. VoidCostModal's own FormModal adds another <form> inside it. The form-ancestor count of the reason input is 2. The browser's native submit of the nested form is not reliably prevented, so a GET navigation happens. Fix: move VoidCostModal outside the outer FormModal (fragment sibling) or portal it to document.body.
